overview.description: Estimated time from when all parts are received at the manufacturer assembly facility to when the finished bike ships to the D2C customer. Includes all inbound supplier lead times as a separate field. Assembly is performed at our contract manufacturer facility in Kent, WA.
overview.facility: Apex Cycles Contract Assembly — Kent, WA
overview.units_per_line_per_shift: Varies by model — see per-bike estimates

supplier_lead_times.note: AlpineShox ships air freight; transit adds 5 days to 45-day production lead. All other suppliers converge by day 40-43.

time_summary.note_on_batch: Batch production amortizes setup, kitting, and wheel truing jig time. 50-unit run assumes dedicated wheel builder.

supplier_lead_times.note: Carbon frame is sea-freighted via Taichung Port; 18-day transit adds to 42-day production lead. STI shifters (SUP-002, 35 days) arrive in parallel.

fleet_summary.shared_bottleneck: Veloforge Industries (SUP-001, Taiwan) is the frame supplier for all 6 models and represents the single largest supply risk. Diversifying frame sourcing is recommended.
